claims.text: Setting the PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN environment variable on the self-hosted Pulumi Cloud API service lets Terraform and OpenTofu use the self-hosted Pulumi Cloud as a state backend.
PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN is an environment variable on the self-hosted Pulumi Cloud API service that specifies the domain serving the Terraform-compatible API.
When PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN is unset, the Terraform-compatible API is disabled and its routes aren't registered in self-hosted Pulumi Cloud.
PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN can be set to the same value as PULUMI_API_DOMAIN, so a separate domain or second DNS record is not required.
The DNS record for the PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN domain should point at the same host that serves PULUMI_API_DOMAIN.
The state backend guide uses `tf.pulumi.com` as the domain in the Terraform/OpenTofu configuration, `terraform login`/`tofu login`, and the `TF_TOKEN_*` variable name.
A page exists at /docs/integrations/terraform/state-backend/ documenting the Terraform state backend.
